initialResult: verify failed, publication skipped; npm and GitHub release endpoints both returned404

fixes.cause: Node exposes runner CPU count; original tests assumed30fps but four-or-fewer cores select20fps.
fixes.change: Use an explicit8-core fixture and add2-core,4-core,8-core and low-memory cadence/cleanup cases.

fixes.cause: A consumer type assertion redundantly typechecked the entire implementation inside Vitest, exceeding5seconds on GitHub.
fixes.change: Keep real consumer diagnostics and Form symbol assertions; full implementation checking remains mandatory in npm run typecheck.

retry.method: Retarget only the unpublished failed-attempt tag using an exact force-with-lease; original commit retained in main history and tag object retained in a local backup ref.

publishPathRecovery.cause: npm parses a bare release/name.tgz specifier as a GitHub repository, not a local tarball.
publishPathRecovery.fix: Use npm publish "./$ARCHIVE"; a regression test resolves the actual workflow argument using npm-package-arg.
